rdfs:label: comment
rdfs:comment: A comment on the subject — typically a Comment instance written by some agent in response to the subject.
notes: Property form paired with the `urn:solid:Comment` class. Maps to `schema:comment` (a comment in response to the subject), distinct from `rdfs:comment` (a human-readable description of a vocabulary term). Use `comment` for user-generated reply content; use `rdfs:comment` (or `urn:solid:description`) for descriptive prose about a resource.
